question: Can any independent per-day floor/ceil selection of the reconstructed four-place M value bridge all four source-printed six-place solar totals?

inputs.scope: One physical G893 copy; original S/J row collation, 181 numeric S and 183 ordinary J
Four source-original six-place prose totals; separate Waseda comparison
Earlier narrow retained-tail hypotheses; not generalized by this batch

model.M4_formula: M4[d] = M4[0] - d*S4[0] - step4*d*(d-1)/2, in printed 1/10000 分 units; d=0 is 初日
model.per_day_quantization_family: For each reconstructed positive M4[d], independently choose q[d] between floor(M4[d]/100) and ceil(M4[d]/100), both inclusive, integer microdegrees. J_micro[d] = 1000000 + sign*q[d]. Choices may vary arbitrarily by day; this encompasses daily floor, daily ceiling, and nearest rounding of this same M4.
model.baseline: The 13SM original J cells reproduce J_micro[d]=1000000+sign*floor(M4[d]/100) for both seasons. This does not establish the original historical computation of M/C or a carry rule.
model.skip_initial_total: 1000000 + sum(J_micro[d]) over ordinary D1...Dterminal; the initial day is replaced with a plain degree, as an explicitly conditional arithmetic normalization of 13SK's observed full-minus-skip pairs.
model.exclusion_scope: If historical totals used a distinct intermediate higher-precision M, another carry unit, hidden input, rounding before accumulation or an inherited aggregate, these bounds do not apply.

received_text_locator_controls.provider: National Institute of Korean History modern received text
received_text_locator_controls.caution: May index a historical wording; its 少 cannot be assigned a numerical radix or equated to another work's 微 solely by numeric agreement

received_text_locator_controls.recorded_phrase: 置立差三十一微，以六因之，得一秒八十六微
received_text_locator_controls.caution: Different textual layer and formula representation; similar 1.86 numerals neither establish direct borrowing nor identify a G893 少/微 carry

adjudication.positive: For the explicit unchanged four-place M4 day model, all ordinary S/J observations replay, and ANY per-day integer microdegree selection between the floor and ceiling of each daily M4 contribution is bounded by the intervals above.
adjudication.excluded: The summer source prose total exceeds the maximum day-sum for BOTH full and skip-initial models by 20 microdegrees. No combination of daily floor/ceiling/nearest choices applied only to the same reconstructed M4 can produce it; hence this entire conditional family cannot explain all four original prose totals.
adjudication.not_excluded: Separate upstream retained precision, different operation/rounding order, independent prose aggregation or transmitted numbers not computed as a sum of printed daily J, and historical unit values not securely established.
adjudication.textual_firewall: Both received transcriptions are discovery/lexical controls only, not a direct original-source 少/微 radix decision or proof of textual lineage.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: A numeric interval failure does not prove that the original six-place prose totals were copied or arose from another edition.
A received 少 versus 微 wording contrast is not an identity or transmission edge.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Find a physically and chronologically bound original same-field 少/微 rule with unit/carry or independently retained higher-precision input.
Identify which source or working algorithm generated the four prose aggregates.

next: Do not repeat four-place S/J collation or try ad-hoc daily J rounding to close the +20 summer residual. Prioritize a separate authenticated original same-field carry/retained input, maintaining G893 six historical finals 0/6 OPEN.
